title: Outside Maz's Castle
description: On planet Takodana, Maz Kanata told Han Solo that he must personally return BB-8 to General Leia of the Resistance. Although Rey was expected to accompany him, Finn confessed to her that he was a former Stormtrooper, and that he no longer wanted to be a combatant for any cause, no matter how just. The two sadly bid farewell to each other at Maz's castle, just as Rey suddenly found herself being distracted by a strange, unidentifiable sound.
section: Star Wars: The Force Awakens #9 of 20
